aopui.help.title: Setting details
aopui.help.hint: Point to a setting or select its control with the keyboard to read its description.
aopui.help.no_description: No description is provided for this setting.
aopui.server.help: World settings. Multiplayer editing requires OP level 4.
aopui.discard.title: Discard unsaved server changes?
aopui.discard.help: Refresh reloads the server values and clears this screen's draft.
aopui.error.invalid: Invalid value. Check the field or its allowed range.
aopui.error.denied: Access denied. Multiplayer editing requires OP 4.
aopui.error.stale: Settings changed elsewhere. Refresh before saving again.
aopui.error.save: Could not save. The previous in-memory values were restored.
aopui.error.connection: Connection lost or timed out. Changes were not confirmed.
aopui.error.no_world: Enter a world to view its server settings.
aopui.error.too_large: Too many changes for one request. Save smaller groups.
